status: the release binary since 2026-10-13 (branch feature/csmwrap-acpi10): installer/cmd/usos-efisign/release.go stages it with the source archive, the six patches and the licence notices; tools/xp_csmwrap_esp.sh and the BIOS Core DOS installer pin its hash
naming: 3.1.2-usos5 = 3.1.2-usos4 + patch 0006 (ACPI 1.0 view: RSDT from the XSDT, 32-bit FADT fields from the X_ fields, opt-in ACPI 1.0 FADT for Windows 2000). Earlier: usos4 = usos3 + patch 0005, usos3 = usos1 + patch 0004.
modified: MODIFIED version of CSMWrap 3.1.2 and of its SeaBIOS fork: quiet boot unless csmwrap.ini sets verbose = true (patches 0001-0003, as in 3.1.2-usos1), and SeaBIOS CSM boot priorities looked up in CSMWrap's BBS table by PCI address, USB mass storage included (patch 0004, 2026-09-29); the exact disk CSMWrap was loaded from becomes BIOS drive 0x80 also when other disks share its controller (patch 0005, 2026-10-11: CSMWrap tags its BBS entry with an FNV-1a hash of its sector 0, SeaBIOS moves the matching hard disk first, the others keep their order); and an ACPI 1.0 view for legacy systems on CSMWrap's RSDP copy (patch 0006, 2026-10-13: RsdtAddress 0 / invalid RSDT / RSDT without the FACP or APIC the XSDT lists -> a new RSDT from the XSDT entries below 4 GiB; FADT 32-bit FIRMWARE_CTRL/DSDT/PM/GPE fields 0 with the X_ field set below 4 GiB -> a FADT copy with them filled, referenced from the RSDT only; csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true (written only for Windows 2000 with ACPI) -> the RSDT FADT is always a copy cut to revision 1 / 116 bytes, because the 2000 ACPI HALs copy FADT.Length bytes into a 0x84-byte buffer; a valid 1.0 view without the option is left untouched; logged as "USOS ACPI10")

source_archive.note: unpatched 3.1.2 tree with all submodules and seabios/.version (shared with 3.1.2-usos1); the usos3 source is this archive plus patches/*.patch applied in order with patch -p1

upstream_rebuild.note: the same source and toolchain built WITHOUT patches in each run: matches 3.1.2-usos1/manifest.json upstream_rebuild

build.host: Alpine Linux 3.24.1 virt live ISO in QEMU 11.1.0 (WHPX), kernel 6.18.35-0-virt
build.toolchain: gcc 15.2.0-r5 (Alpine), binutils 2.45.1-r1, nasm 3.01-r0, xxd 9.2.1178-r0 (9.2.1091-r0 was superseded on the v3.24 branch on 2026-10-13), make 4.4.1-r4, python3 3.14.8-r0 (3.14.7-r1 was superseded on the v3.24 branch; the unpatched rebuild still matches upstream_rebuild), patch 2.8-r0, GNU tar 1.35-r5, xz 5.8.4-r0, git 2.54.0-r0
build.repeatable: one VM run on 2026-10-13 (tools/csmwrap_build/run_build_vm.py, lock usos_version 3.1.2-usos5, xxd 9.2.1178-r0) building usos5 twice from fresh trees: identical binaries; the unpatched build still matches upstream_rebuild

tests: tools/tests/csmwrap/test_csmwrap_acpi10.py (host unit test of usos_acpi10.c taken from patch 0006, wiring and the xp_csmwrap_esp.sh gate); tools/tests/csmwrap/run_csmwrap_acpi10_qemu.py (OVMF smoke run; q35 A/B 2026-10-13: usos4 black "_" hang, usos5 + acpi_legacy_fadt reaches the kernel)
